sermon.title: Holy Spirit Events
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer walks through the first Holy Spirit events of the New Testament—John filled from the womb, Mary, Elizabeth, Zacharias, Simeon and Anna, and Jesus baptized in the Spirit and led into testing. He explains blasphemy against the Holy Spirit, teaches that Christ’s blood can cleanse even it (Paul in 1 Timothy 1:13), and what Hebrews 6 falling away really means.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: One place name at 18:20 was not clear. Points to check: Solomon “13 years” between visitations; that Paul “killed an innocent man” (Stephen—Acts 7–8 says he consented) and that the Old Testament said murder of the innocent would not be forgiven. Doctrinal positions kept as spoken: the unpardonable sin can be forgiven, Elizabeth’s prophecy as the office of a prophet, women used in the church, not receiving the Spirit at water baptism, Jesus growing body parts, faith-camp “gain is godliness.”

chunks.section_question: What does John the Baptist teach about waiting on the Spirit?
chunks.short_answer: Luke 1:15: John would be filled with the Holy Spirit from his mother’s womb, yet thirty years passed before he ministered. You can’t manufacture a move of the Holy Spirit; respond when he moves, and if it takes days or years, hang in there.

chunks.section_question: Who is least and who is greatest in the kingdom?

Matthew 5:19: whoever breaks the least commandments—the baby doctrines of Hebrews 6 like repentance, baptisms and laying on of hands—and teaches others to break them is least. The greatest do and teach righteousness.

chunks.section_question: What does the Holy Ghost coming on Mary show?

chunks.section_question: What happened to Elizabeth and Zacharias?
chunks.short_answer: When Mary greeted Elizabeth, the baby leaped for joy and Elizabeth, filled with the Holy Ghost, prophesied things not yet revealed. Zacharias, whose barren wife bore John in old age, was filled with the Holy Ghost and prophesied. Sons and daughters prophesy, so God uses women in the church while keeping structure in the home.

chunks.section_question: What did the Holy Spirit do for Simeon and Anna?
chunks.short_answer: Luke 2:25: the Holy Ghost revealed to Simeon he would see the Lord’s Christ, led him to the temple, and he held Jesus and prophesied salvation for all nations, a light to the Gentiles. The Spirit gives a hunger to assemble (Hebrews 10:25) to meet Jesus. Anna, 84, also prophesied.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon, and this man was just and devout, waiting for the Consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him. And it had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ. So he came by the Spirit into the temple. And when the parents brought in the Child Jesus, to do for Him according to the custom of the law, he took Him up in his arms and blessed God and said: “Lord, now You are letting Your servant depart in peace, According to Your word; For my eyes have seen Your salvation Which You have prepared before the face of all peoples, A light to bring revelation to the Gentiles, And the glory of Your people Israel.”
not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as is the manner of some, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

Now there was one, Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher. She was of a great age, and had lived with a husband seven years from her virginity; and this woman was a widow of about eighty-four years, who did not depart from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day. And coming in that instant she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of Him to all those who looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

chunks.section_question: What happened when the Spirit descended on Jesus?
chunks.short_answer: Matthew 3:16 and Luke 3:22: the Spirit descended like a dove and the Father spoke—one God, not three. Jesus was baptized in the Holy Spirit as an event, unlike those who say you just get the Spirit at water baptism without any event.

chunks.section_question: Does being filled with the Spirit mean no testing?

faqs.question: Can you manufacture a move of the Holy Spirit?
faqs.answer: No—you must respond when he moves, however long it takes.

faqs.question: Did John the Baptist do miracles?
faqs.answer: No—he did no miracle and didn’t speak in tongues, yet no prophet was greater.

faqs.question: Should we knock the babies in the church?
faqs.answer: No—babies can mature in a few years; look to Jesus.

faqs.question: Can women be used of God in the church?
faqs.answer: Yes—God pours out his Spirit on sons and daughters; keep structure in the home.

faqs.question: Why go to the house of God?
faqs.answer: To meet with Jesus and be edified to love and good works—not to socialize or sell insurance.

faqs.question: Do you get the Holy Spirit automatically at water baptism?
faqs.answer: He says no—Jesus had an event when the Spirit came, and he saw no dove at theirs.

faqs.question: Will being saved mean no problems?
faqs.answer: No—he says he didn’t know he had so many flaws until he got saved, and Jesus was tested.

faqs.question: Does God allow more than we can handle?
faqs.answer: No—he says God won’t; we bring things on ourselves that God didn’t.

faqs.question: Who can be filled with the Holy Spirit?
faqs.answer: All flesh—any believer in a fleshly body is a candidate, though you have to ask.

faqs.question: Does “Trinity” mean three gods?
faqs.answer: No—it is one God expressing himself in three ways.
